type:
@Roth.derivative_aeval : ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (γ : σ → Polynomial K)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ K),
  Polynomial.derivative ((MvPolynomial.aeval γ) P) =
    ∑ j, Polynomial.derivative (γ j) * (MvPolynomial.aeval γ) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) P)
what: Algebraic multivariate chain rule for polynomial coordinate substitution.
how: Polynomial induction on constants, addition and multiplication by one variable; simplification uses Leibniz.
hypotheses: Field K (verified weakenable to CommSemiring R)
Fintype σ for the univ-sum spelling
Arbitrary γ : σ → Polynomial K and P : MvPolynomial σ K
caller_summary: One same-file explicit caller: private Roth.derivative_kronHasse_aux at GenWronskian.lean:159; zero external-to-file callers; exact293 canonical audit confirms direct consumer.

moral_duplications: Standard multivariable analogue of the existing univariate chain rule; no verified existing ≤3-call replacement.
generalization: Verified Field→CommSemiring; arbitrary algebra/module-valued derivation; arbitrary-variable finite-support sum over P.vars.
